verdicts.rationale: REST v2 upsert fails to respect autoID. INSERT without ID succeeds (auto-generated), UPSERT without ID fails (error 1804). UPSERT with explicit ID succeeds. Inconsistent - both should respect autoID. Contract says if autoID disabled PK required (implying if autoID enabled PK optional). INSERT implements correctly, UPSERT violates. True behavioral defect.
